enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Coruscating 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 4d6 Light damage on each hit.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.

Banishing: On Hit: 4 to 24 Bane damage to Outsiders.On Vorpal Hit: If an outsider struck by this weapon has fewer than 1000 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the outsider has above 1000 Hit Points, it takes 100 damage.
Flametouched Iron: Flametouched Iron grants +1 saves versus Evil Outsiders.
Inevitable Balance: Your represent balance beneath the depths... +5 Melee Power, 5% Doublestrike, Your Sneak Attacks do additional Bane damage
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
